changelog:
Initial release of Google Workspace skill with zero setup complexity:

- Access Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Chat, and more — no Google Cloud Console required, just OAuth sign-in.
- Install and configure instantly with a single command; credentials managed automatically.
- Includes 49 tools for searching, reading, creating, updating, and sending within all major Google Workspace apps.
- Simple troubleshooting and re-authentication workflows provided.
- Example commands for common actions included in documentation.
summary: Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets — NO Google Cloud Console required. Just OAuth sign-in. Zero setup complexity vs traditional Google API integrations.
